artifact_reasoning: While structurally sound, the image exhibits minor generative artifacts. The gill slits are the most notable defect, lacking sharp anatomical boundaries and appearing slightly blurred into the skin (Router severity 2.0 is appropriate). The tip of the cephalofoil shows minor geometric softness/rounding (Router severity 1.5 is appropriate).
